purpose: Teach: 最短/溶接/果樹/各紙/三国/記念碑/海運/布教

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務の、本気で、絶対、最短ルート、絶対、見直しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Review the operational workflow. I'm serious — find the shortest route. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Sharp attack on 「業務」. Staccato pacing. No breath for negotiation. Lean forward slightly. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の溶接、本気で、絶対、品質管理、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling factory welding with rigorous quality control. We appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Measured, professional cadence. Steady eye contact. Slight emphasis on 「品質管理」 — demonstrating he takes it seriously. Respectful but not servile. The assurance of competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地方の果樹農家、本気で、絶対、提携、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Work on expanding partnerships with local fruit farmers. Move it forward seriously.
lines.style: Direct, decisive. Short breath between phrases. No room for delay. Expectation of immediate action in the voice. Slightly forward posture — this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各紙の経済面、本気で、絶対、当社の取材、絶対、入っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've already secured coverage in the economic sections of major papers. We're grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Composed, matter-of-fact. Pride threading underneath — showing tangible results. Steady pace. Slight lift at 「入っております」 — small note of achievement without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 三国時代の、本気で、絶対、貿易を、絶対、研究、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Study the Three Kingdoms era trade routes. Use that as your reference point. I need you focused on this.
lines.style: Thoughtful but commanding. Slower opening, then firmer. The teacher in him showing. Weight on 「研究」. Expectation that this connects to something larger. Composed authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業地の、本気で、絶対、記念碑、絶対、補修、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively restoring the monument at our founding location. We're moving forward on this.
lines.style: Steady, focused. Clear pride in the legacy work. Deliberate on 「補修」 — this matters to the company. Even pace. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海運業界、本気で、絶対、再編、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch the shipping industry carefully. Pay attention to restructuring moves. It's critical we stay ahead.
lines.style: Intense focus. Sharp opening on 「海運業界」. Lower, more urgent tone. Forward lean. The voice of someone reading a changing market. Slight urgency without panic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外への布教を、本気で、絶対、目指す団体様、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively supporting organizations dedicated to spreading Japanese culture overseas. It's part of our mission.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formality. Slight expansion on 「ご支援」 — genuine about this commitment. Steady, purposeful pacing. The professional voice with a humanistic heart showing through.
